original.title: agent_context facts table fetched without a row limit — unbounded growth increases per-request token cost
original.fix_hint: Verify whether `sanitizeFacts` in lib/agents/save-facts.ts applies a count limit (the file was not provided). If it does not, add `.limit(50)` to the query and/or cap the list in `sanitizeFacts` to a maximum number of facts (e.g. 50) to bound token usage per request.
original.explanation: Every agent chat request fetches all facts for the user from `agent_context` with no LIMIT clause. The `sanitizeFacts` helper applies length limits per fact but does not cap the total number of facts fetched from the database. As a user accumulates facts over time (each conversation can add up to 10 new facts via `<save_facts>` blocks), the full list is prepended to every Claude request. This increases token consumption and therefore API cost proportionally with the number of stored facts, with no ceiling.
original.observation: The query at lines 217-222 selects all `content` rows for the user with no `.limit()`. The `sanitizeFacts` call at line 224 truncates individual fact strings but does not limit the count. The `buildFactBlock` function receives the full list.

narrative_projection.previous_fix_hint: Verify whether `sanitizeFacts` in lib/agents/save-facts.ts applies a count limit (the file was not provided). If it does not, add `.limit(50)` to the query and/or cap the list in `sanitizeFacts` to a maximum number of facts (e.g. 50) to bound token usage per request.
